description: Pulser Pulse is a team of curious, passionate innovators driven by technology, engineering, and creative problem-solving. We combine diverse ideas, analytical thinking, and a willingness to experiment. Our project is an interactive lunar/Martian outpost simulator where players manage resources, overcome challenges, and experience real engineering trade-offs.
summary: Outpost zero is an engaging martian outpost simulator that incorporates real life nasa data with endlessly entertaning gameplay. It gives real life engineering trade offs in space mission a more approachable and fun way of experiencing. By having resource management tradeoffs, communication delays, radiation protection management. It is a gateway for young learners to cherish their curiosity and intrigue for space while also understanding how real operations work, this helps the next generation of space loving talents.
details: Outpost Zero is a martian outpost that blends fun and interactive problem solving with engineering trade-offs faced in real space operations. In this game you are the commander of space base in mars where your duty is to keep you and your team alive and grow this base for other habitants. Manage Power, Oxygen, Food and Radiation protection while simultaneously making decision that have caveats. This game is accessible enough for young learners to enjoy while being informative enough for them to learn about decision making and space resource management. We intend for this game to inspire and nurture young learner's curiosity in an era where kids attentions are a commodity, this leads to a generation of aspiring astronauts and space specialists. To make this game we used Godot game engine paired GDscript , including the help of A.I tools like Claude and OpenCode to debug and structure game features, Furthermore, we used Netifly to host this game online that can be accessed easily through a browser. We wanted to make game where learning and experiencing these space operations and engineering trade offs didn't feel another quiz, we made Outpost Zero to be immersive, intriguing and educational all at the same time by making one feature affect another this way the player learns to balance the decision based on scenario.
